title: Acting on a term another user renamed after the page loaded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Sign in with the "Admin" role in one browser, and have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Choose a new name for term B, that no term has.
  • Start with the Credit Terms page open on the Active tab in both browsers.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. In user B's browser, click "Edit".
  3. In user B's browser, replace the Name with the name of term B.
  4. In user B's browser, click "Save Changes".
  5. In your browser, without reloading, click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  6. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  7. Click "Make Default".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • User B's menu opens.

Step 2:

  • User B's "Edit Credit Term" window opens.

Step 3:

  • The Name reads term B.

Step 4:

  • User B sees the toast "term B saved".

Step 5:

  • Your menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 7:

  • The save is refused with the reason the PO gives (see the note).
  • The page keeps its state.

The PRD says a change by another user is refused "with the reason in S2 Error Handling", but none of those texts covers a rename. Question 3 on Chris Ward's sheet (shared with him 23 Oct 2026) asks; this case is held until he answers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-E2: “If a term becomes in use, becomes the default, or is changed by another user after the page loaded, the save is refused with the reason in S2 Error Handling, and the page keeps its state.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
